claims.statement: UK remote licensees must run ongoing identify-act-evaluate customer-interaction systems, understand individual impact, evaluate overall effectiveness, and remain responsible when third parties are used.
The UK code requires manual review of strong-harm automated actions and an opportunity for the customer to contest an automated decision.
The regulated GB remote casino, betting and bingo sector generated GBP7.8 billion GGY in April 2024-March 2025 and had 24.4 million active accounts at the final quarter end.
A 2025 GBP10 million enforcement action cited failures in a remote operator's customer-interaction system, demonstrating material compliance pain but not willingness to buy this product.

Behavioral risk scoring is personal-data profiling; current ICO guidance requires lawful basis, transparency, accuracy safeguards, challenge paths and risk assessment, while UK automated-decision guidance is being updated after the 2025 law change.
Mindway AI already provides operator-scale harm detection and in June 2026 announced an evidence-led intervention-selection and outcome-evaluation capability closely overlapping this thesis.

contrary_evidence: Mindway AI is building the same intervention-selection and outcome-evaluation layer atop an installed risk product.
Platform suppliers such as EveryMatrix already bundle responsible-gaming and compliance controls.
A July 2026 UK pilot trial found no clear intervention advantage over active control, underscoring mixed causal evidence.
The EU recommendation is non-binding and does not create one harmonised EU procurement requirement.

economics.acquisition_route: Sell an audit-mode pilot through one player-account or CRM platform, with the operator retaining policy control; avoid direct multi-jurisdiction expansion until one regulator-ready evaluation is demonstrated.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Planning case, not validated: 30 operators at 20000 PLN blended monthly revenue is 7.2 million PLN ARR. At 18-25% operating margin and retained founder control, sustained profit could support more than 5 million PLN founder net worth; enterprise sales, pricing and competitive survival are unproven.
economics.founder_time: About 4 founder hours daily for analytics, governance and one channel integration; a responsible-gambling specialist, privacy counsel and security contractor are required.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Planning range of 55-70% after platform share, security, model monitoring, specialist review and support; no public pricing or cost evidence validates it.
economics.payback: Unknown because regulated procurement and security review duration are unobserved; require a paid pilot and less than 18-month contribution payback before a second platform integration.
economics.pricing: Test 25000 PLN setup and 8000 PLN monthly audit-mode pilot, later moving toward 20000 PLN blended monthly operator revenue; these are hypotheses, not market observations.
economics.retention_or_repeat: The code requires ongoing monitoring and evaluation, but retention depends on demonstrable safer outcomes and regulator-ready records rather than detection alone.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Strictly purpose-limited and contractually permissioned response labels improve intervention selection while excluding promotional reuse
fingerprint.customer: Mid-sized licensed remote gambling operators and compliance teams not already locked into an incumbent outcome layer
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Embedded integration through one player-account or gambling-CRM platform vendor
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Protective-intervention orchestration, audit and evaluation API sold by setup and operator subscription
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The operator pays for a regulator-ready intervention evaluation loop and recorded outcome coverage
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A player crosses a harm-risk threshold and a protective action must be chosen, reviewed and evaluated

founder_fit: Behavioral analytics and experimentation fit the founder's data-science background and interest in betting.
The product is protective and non-promotional, but regulated enterprise sales and governance are heavier than the founder's preferred low-social-energy model.
Clinical, privacy and regulatory authority can be contracted; the founder should not personally define harm policy without specialists.
risks: Wrong or commercially influenced interventions can worsen harm; promotional teams must be technically and contractually barred from using risk labels.
Mindway AI and platform incumbents can bundle or block the capability.
Cross-operator pooling may lack lawful basis, contractual rights or comparable outcome definitions.
Automated restrictions require meaningful review, transparency, contestability, security and jurisdiction-specific governance.
Sparse causal evidence can make claimed outcome lift misleading.

structure.control_point: The auditable loop linking detected risk, reviewed protective action and measured post-action outcome
structure.critical_dependency: One operator-platform deployment, regulator-aligned evaluation, specialist governance and lawful purpose-limited behavioral-data processing

thesis: Embed an audit-first responsible-gambling intervention and evaluation loop in one player-account or CRM platform, charging operators for regulator-ready outcome coverage while strictly separating harm labels from promotion and preserving human review.
title: SaferPlay Intervention Outcomes API
uncertainties: Whether a platform and operator will grant deployment and purpose-limited outcome rights.
Whether any lawful, comparable cross-operator dataset can be formed.
Incremental causal lift over operator rules, Mindway AI and platform-native controls.
Enterprise security, insurance, legal and procurement costs within founder capital.
Achievable price and sales cycle for mid-sized operators.
